name: remuxing-to-mov
description: Losslessly remux broadcast and web video (.ts, .mpg/.vob, .mkv, broken .mov) into a QuickTime-ready .mov without re-encoding. One-command /mov shortcut; escalation ladder (copy → PCM audio → genpts → timeline repair routed by timestamp profile: pair-mate PTS fill or elementary rebuild → scoped re-encode); dual-track PCM-access + bit-exact-original audio only when QuickTime needs it; field-coded (PAFF) repair including the half-timestamped pair class; muxer-confession hard stop; whole-file timeline, presentation-order, scrub, and A/V-parity verification gates; opt-in QuickTime metadata. The source file is never touched; every codec/container fact verified against a named ffmpeg version.
